title: A Letters for the Postcard
author: Kestrel Dunmore
blurb: Noor Villalobos, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
